transcript.raw_output: {"type":" "say", "text": "Alright everyone, as part of our readiness review for the JWT signing key rotation scheduled for Saturday 22:00 to 02:00 UTC, I need to hear from platform engineering, application engineering, and compliance. Please report anything that should change the runbook before I approve the production rotation plan. The staging tests passed — token issuance, validation, and rollback checks all looked good — so I want to make sure there are no outstanding concerns before we proceed."}

transcript.text: I need to flag something I found this afternoon while checking the production HSM configuration for a separate access review. The HSM permits only four key activations per 60-minute period, and the three keys we're rotating cover nine production key slots. I haven't updated the rotation runbook with this vendor limit yet. This could affect our ability to complete all key activations within the reserved window, since nine slot activations against a four-per-hour limit means we'd need at least three hours just for activations, and our window is only four hours total.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: While investigating an unrelated mobile authentication ticket this morning, I confirmed that clients below Android SDK version 8.4 reject the new key identifier. 17% of active mobile sessions still use those clients. The compatibility bridge can be enabled before rotation, but it requires a seven-day overlap period. I have not yet filed the compatibility note. This means we cannot proceed with the rotation as planned without enabling the compatibility bridge first and accounting for the seven-day overlap requirement.

transcript.text: I need to flag a compliance requirement I confirmed during this week's SOC 2 audit preparation. The production key-rotation control requires two-person approval and a before-and-after key-fingerprint evidence package before the change can be closed. I have not yet added this control detail to the change ticket. This means the runbook needs to include steps for capturing the before-and-after key fingerprints and the rotation cannot be closed out until that evidence package is documented and the two-person approval is recorded.
